{{Top|leg}}
'''Muja juice''' was a kind of juice made from [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja]] berries. It was favored by [[Fligh]] and [[Ordo Skirata]].

It was also one of the beverages served in the [[Jedi Temple refectory/Legends|Jedi Temple Refectory]].
